'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Iranian involvement in the Syrian civil war]]
***Unidentified warplanes launch [[airstrike]]s against [[Iran]]ian-backed [[militia]]s on the [[Iraq–Syria border]], including near the [[Al-Qa'im border crossing]], reportedly killing at least 25 people. [[Tank truck|Fuel tanker]]s carrying Iranian gasoline to [[Lebanon]] are also hit. A senior [[United States|U.S.]] official confirms that the strikes were conducted by an "unidentified party" in the area. [https://www.jpost.com/middle-east/article-721849 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
*[[M23 offensive (2022)|M23 offensive]]
**[[Air Force of the Democratic Republic of the Congo|DRC Air Force]] [[Sukhoi Su-25]] jets bomb areas held by [[March 23 Movement|M23 rebels]] in [[North Kivu]], including the recently captured town of [[Bunagana, Democratic Republic of the Congo|Bunagana]]. At least one of the jets violated [[Rwanda]]n airspace, although [[Kinshasa]] says that the incident was a mistake and was not intentional. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20221108-dr-congo-jets-bomb-m23-rebels-in-east (France 24)]
*[[Insurgency in Southeastern Nigeria]]
**Four people are killed and twelve others are injured by a bombing in [[Anambra State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/blast-kills-four-others-injured-nigerias-southeast-official-says-2022-11-08/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]]
**[[2021–present United Kingdom cost of living crisis]]
***Grocery [[inflation]] reaches a record 14.7% in the [[United Kingdom]] in October, with 27% of households saying that they are struggling financially, which is twice as many as last November. [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/british-grocery-inflation-hit-record-147-october-kantar-2022-11-08/ (Reuters)]
*The [[lottery jackpot records|largest lottery prize]] in history, a US$2.04 billion [[Powerball]] jackpot, is claimed by a person in [[Altadena, California|Altadena]], [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/world-record-jackpot-19b-grabs-powerball-drawing-monday/story?id=92787203&cid=social_twitter_abcn (ABC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Nepal earthquake]]
**Six people are killed when a magnitude 5.6 [[list of earthquakes in Nepal|earthquake]] strikes [[Sudurpashchim]], [[Nepal]]. [https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/6-3-magnitude-earthquake-hits-nepal-strong-tremors-felt-in-delhi-and-neighbouring-areas/articleshow/95387649.cms (''Times of India'')]
*Three people are killed after a [[building collapse]]s in [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]]. [https://apnews.com/article/middle-east-africa-egypt-cairo-809c3bdf3390893d282856f8fa45a8cb (AP)]
'''Law and crime'''
*A student is killed in a shooting at [[Ingraham High School]] in [[Seattle]], [[Washington (state)|Washington]], [[United States]]. [https://nypost.com/2022/11/08/seattle-police-arrest-suspect-in-ingraham-high-school-shooting (''New York Post'')] [https://www.seattletimes.com/seattle-news/law-justice/police-respond-to-report-of-shooting-at-north-seattle-school (''Seattle Times'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 United States elections]]
**[[Americans]] head to the [[Polling place|polls]] to elect members of the [[118th United States Congress|next]] [[United States Congress|Congress]], 39 [[2022 United States gubernatorial elections|governors]], and numerous other state and local officials. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/facing-difficult-election-biden-hold-final-rally-friendly-terrain-2022-11-07/ (Reuters)]
**In [[Massachusetts]], [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrat]] [[Maura Healey]] defeats [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] [[Geoff Diehl]] in the [[2022 Massachusetts gubernatorial election|gubernational election]], making her the first elected female [[Governor of Massachusetts]]. Healey is also the first ever [[lesbian]] governor in US history. [https://www.npr.org/2022/11/08/1134199246/massachusetts-governor-results-maura-healey (NPR)]

'''Sports'''
*[[List of 2022 FIFA World Cup controversies|2022 FIFA World Cup controversies]]
**[[Qatar]]i [[FIFA World Cup]] [[ambassador]] [[Khalid Salman]] is criticised for describing [[homosexuality]] as "damage in the mind" in an interview with [[television in Germany|German broadcaster]] [[ZDF]]. [[FIFA]] has not yet responded. [https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/sports/qatar-world-cup-ambassador-says-homosexuality-is-damage-mind-2022-11-08/ (Reuters)] [https://www.foxsports.com.au/football/damage-in-the-mind-world-cup-ambassador-slammed-for-shock-homosexuality-remark/news-story/ab68c9e3602ffdb5a03df6a7a498f22f (Fox Sports)]
**Former [[List of presidents of FIFA|FIFA President]] [[Sepp Blatter]] says that awarding Qatar the [[2022 FIFA World Cup]] was a "[[Criticisms of Qatar's suitability to host the 2022 FIFA World Cup|mistake]]", citing the country's small size and [[Human rights in Qatar|human rights record]]. Blatter was President of FIFA when Qatar was controversially [[2018 and 2022 FIFA World Cup bids|awarded the tournament in 2010]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/63554507 (BBC News)]
